svg.desc: Star history for leereilly/github-high-scores over 1 year. 131 current stars. 3 recorded additions in range. 2025-09-28 to 2026-09-20. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges.
